'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 John Anderson DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]]
* '''Username:''' puck71
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
